paper.title_en: Entanglement Bounds on Cardy Growth in Higher Dimensions
paper.abstract_en: We propose bounds relating thermal entropy to entanglement in unitary conformal field theories: $f\le4π^2a$ in four dimensions and $f\le2.99830949\ldots\,F$ in three dimensions. Here $f$ is the dimensionless coefficient of the cosmological constant term in the thermal effective action, $a$ is the Euler anomaly coefficient, and $F$ is the sphere free energy. These bounds arise naturally as the high-temperature limits of proposed inequalities for spherical Rényi entropy that extend the conformal collider bound in four dimensions and an analogous conjecture in three dimensions. To verify this proposal, we formulate a stronger conjectural inequality common to both dimensions, expressed in terms of the stress-tensor three-point function and saturated by every free theory. We establish this inequality in controlled regimes of weakly coupled gauge theories, large-$N$ vector models, and holographic CFTs. Finite-$N$ numerical results provide additional support. Our proposal suggests that the equality between the universal coefficients governing the Cardy formula and entanglement entropy in two-dimensional CFTs extends to higher dimensions in the form of a universal inequality.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该工作提出热熵与纠缠熵之间的普适不等式，涉及四维Euler反常系数与三维球面自由能，并在弱耦合规范理论、大N矢量模型与全息CFT中验证，同时给出有限N数值支持，理论上具有一定深度且与热力学/纠缠主题相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出在幺正共形场论中把热熵与纠缠联系起来的界：四维中 $f\le4\pi^2a$，三维中 $f\le2.99830949\ldots\,F$。这里 $f$ 是热有效作用中宇宙学常数项的无量纲系数，$a$ 是Euler反常系数，$F$ 是球面自由能。这些界自然地作为所提出的球面Rényi熵不等式的高温极限出现，后者推广了四维中的共形对撞机界以及三维中的一个类似猜想。为验证这一提议，我们表述了一个同时适用于两个维度的更强的猜想性不等式，用应力张量三点函数表示，并被每一个自由理论所饱和。我们在弱耦合规范理论、大-$N$矢量模型和全息CFT的可控区域中确立了该不等式。有限-$N$数值结果提供了额外支持。我们的提议表明，二维CFT中支配Cardy公式的普适系数与纠缠熵之间的相等关系，以普适不等式的形式推广到更高维度。
